description: Two turns: the second is a separate process, `claude -p --resume <id>`.
steps: claude -p --output-format json --permission-mode bypassPermissions --strict-mcp-config --session-id 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004 "Read notes.txt and summarise it in one line."

claude -p --output-format json --permission-mode bypassPermissions --strict-mcp-config --resume 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004 "How many list items does notes.txt have? Answer from what you read before, with one number."
